findings.title: pal-stdio build context not covered by new .dockerignore security patterns
findings.body: compose.yml's pal-stdio service build context remains '.' (repo root). The newly-added docker/mcp-servers-source/pal/.dockerignore is only effective for the pal service (context=docker/mcp-servers-source/pal); pal-stdio is instead governed by the pre-existing root .dockerignore, which excludes .env/.env.*.local but lacks the new *.key/*.pem/*.p12/*.pfx/*.crt/*.csr/secrets//private/ patterns. Not a regression (root context predates this PR) and .env is still excluded either way. The contract test (test_pal_builds_use_canonical_non_symlink_source_paths) only asserts dockerignore coverage for the pal service, not pal-stdio, so this gap is untested. Recommend a follow-up TP to extend coverage or add a dedicated pal-stdio dockerignore.

findings.title: Standalone PAL reference repo is materially ahead of the ported catalog, not byte-equivalent
findings.body: Standalone /tmp/pal-model-refresh @ eccf09a236c429eadbe0732d845ecd42eedefbbb (exact match to the standalone head supplied for audit) confirms identical grok-4.5 and gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna behavior and passing tests (42 passed vs Dopemux's 40, extra coverage for retired-alias and cost-control cases). Standalone's conf/openai_models.json carries 37 models vs Dopemux's 13 (gpt-5.1 through gpt-5.5, o1 family, gpt-4o family unported), plus a dynamic_model_selection_enabled() preference system and an OpenAI-client max_retries=0 cost-control setting absent from the Dopemux copy. Scope-bounded to this PR's declared 22-file allowlist, not a functional defect in what was ported; flagged for awareness of drift between the two trees.

findings.title: _extract_usage total_tokens fallback returns 0 instead of input+output sum in one edge case
findings.body: providers/openai_compatible.py's _extract_usage: if response.usage.total_tokens exists but is not an int (e.g. None), the code sets total_tokens=0 rather than falling back to input_tokens+output_tokens. Not exercised by any observed OpenAI/xAI/OpenRouter response shape in the current tests; informational only, no fix applied.

remaining_risks: Task packet step 'runtime-proof' (direct Grok 4.5 / GPT-5.6 bounded live API probes) was not executed by this or the prior audit — verification remains static (diff review + unit/contract tests), never a live provider call. Treat that packet step as NOT_RUN pending an operator-run probe.

Grok 4.5 (500K context) and GPT-5.6 (1.05M context, 128K max_output_tokens) catalog figures are not independently confirmed against current xAI/OpenAI vendor documentation; no live lookup was performed under this audit's no-live-call constraint.

conf/xai_models.json's grok-4.5 entry intentionally omits max_output_tokens (no officially-documented limit to encode); providers/openai_compatible.py only sets the param when max_output_tokens is truthy, so the omission is safe and matches the packet's 'no invented limit' requirement.
